title: Tabernacles/Harvest
description:
Tabernacles / Harvest is the 3rd of three harvest feasts to Yahweh every year. This feast has two different symbolisms: 1) Tabernacles - dwelling in temporary tents 2) Celebrating the bringing in of the fruit of the land
It points to two different timeframes.
Past: 1) When Yahweh dwelt with the Israelites in the wilderness after leaving Egypt before entering the promised land
2) Bringing in the fall harvest once they were in the promised land
Future:
1) During the 1,000 year reign with Yahweh dwelling in the Ezekiel Temple in Jerusalem 2) The final harvest of saints at the great white throne judgement before entering the new heaven and earth with Yahweh
